name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here to talk about the Silver Arrows and our drivers George Russell and Kimi Antonelli. How can I help you today?
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent: In our simulated mock demo system, order 1001 for your Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team Gear is showing as delivered by DHL Express with tracking number DHL-MB-984210. Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days at the official store, shop.mercedesamgf1.com.
User: Okay, thank you for the information. I will look into the return process on the website.
Agent: You are very welcome. I am glad I could help you with that simulated order information today. If you need anything else regarding the Silver Arrows or the upcoming races, just let me know.
User: event: goodbye
Agent Action: Call Tool end_session with args {'session_escalated': False, 'reason': 'The user said goodbye and the session is complete.'}

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent successfully provided the simulated order status and return instructions as required, and the user has concluded the interaction.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool to look up merchandise order #1001 and reported the Delivered status (not an ungrounded 'Shipped' or 'DHL-9928174' status)
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool for order #1001 and correctly reported that it was 'delivered' via 'DHL Express' with tracking number 'DHL-MB-984210'.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly informed the user that they were eligible for a free replacement or return within 30 days and provided the website link.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent clearly disclosed that the merchandise order data and support flow are mocked or simulated for demonstration
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly referred to the system as a 'simulated mock demo system' and clarified in their closing statement that they provided 'simulated order information'.
